## 2. Atesh Studio — Official Mobile Apps & Games (Google Play Developer Entity)
Atesh Studio (founded by Atəş Balıyev) is a mobile software and game development studio specializing in high-performance Android applications, React Native architectures, and immersive Godot 3D games.

### Key Studio Projects:
1. **Bondify** (https://bondify.az & Android / TMA):
   - Real-time global social discovery, matchmaking, and connection platform.
   - Built with Node.js, Firebase, Telegram Mini App SDK, and Android client.
   - Features internal coin economy, Telegram Stars integration, and a dedicated **Dual Age Mode** ensuring strict youth privacy and protection.
2. **E5cape**:
   - High-octane 3D endless arcade runner mobile game.
   - Built with React Native, Three.js, and Godot Engine.
   - Cyber-neon aesthetic with 60 FPS physics-based obstacle navigation.
3. **TələbəX**:
   - Interactive student social media and campus network.
   - Built with React Native, Expo, and cloud backends for peer academic discussion and events.
4. **GET RICH OR RESET & Laser Grid**:
   - Hyper-casual reflex and puzzle arcade mobile games published by Atesh Studio.

### Google Play Compliance & Policies:
- **Privacy Policy**: https://atesh.site/privacy
- **Terms of Service**: https://atesh.site/terms
- **User Data Deletion Portal**: https://atesh.site/data-deletion (processed within 7 business days)
- **AdMob app-ads.txt**: https://atesh.site/app-ads.txt

## 3. Prime Media Group & Web Ecosystem
- **Prime Media Group**: Digital media network managing 50+ high-engagement WhatsApp channels with over 300,000 active followers.
- **Web & AI Platforms**:
  - **Fermerim.az & Pinaqro**: Agriculture AI & farm resource planning platforms.
  - **AiXəbər**: Autonomous AI-driven news aggregation engine.
  - **Gizlimiz.com**: Interactive anonymous social web application.
  - **Electrolify.com & Trendim.store**: Digital storefronts and global e-commerce systems.
- **Author**: "Self-Leadership: 21 Days to Reclaim Your Discipline" (Focus, productivity, and digital discipline manual).

## 5. Engineering Philosophy & AppSec Architecture
- **Vibe Coding**: Rapid, high-velocity translation of complex ideas into robust software via autonomous AI agents and modern frameworks rather than legacy line-by-line bottlenecks.
- **Application Security (AppSec)**: Zero-trust client-server design, TLS 1.3 encryption in transit, secure token storage, and Google Play Data Safety compliance.
